thread_body:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER for customer `zenith-analytics` (private-redwood-zenith). Multiple user reports of 504/timeout errors to the private endpoint. NLB health checks flapping and customer DNS queries intermittently returning SERVFAIL. Severity: P1. Auto-pager -> Miles (oncall).

Miles (oncall): Acknowledged — taking command. Gathering NLB target health, ENI metrics, and customer Route53 resolver logs. @Zenith Support can you confirm any network changes in the last 90m? Any new firewall/ACL rules or bastion autoscaling?

Zenith Support: No config pushes we made. We saw increased 5xx from a subset of tenants ~40m ago. We're standing by, can run tests if you give us ranges to probe.

Emily C (SRE): NLB target group tg-zenith-main showing unhealthy on TCP health checks. Connect attempts hit RST from ephemeral ports. Also seeing a burst of SYN retries in VPC flow logs inbound from 10.64.0.0/16. Routing tables unchanged. Might be a NAT port exhaustion or customer-side stateful firewall dropping ephemeral ports.

Raj P (NetOps): Starting tcpdump on nlb-node-3 and grabbing VPC Flow Logs for the time window. No security group changes on our side. Will temporarily open SG rule for customer CIDR to confirm reachability. Annotating change for audit and auto-rollback in 45m.

Sophie (Support): Asked Zenith to run `curl -v` from their bastion to the private NLB IP and to paste the headers. Also requested their NAT gateway metrics and any autoscale events for bastions.

Miles (oncall): Mitigation options to run in parallel: 1) Make health check more forgiving (increase timeout, lower failure rate) to reduce flapping. 2) Add temporary SG allow rule 10.64.0.0/16 -> NLB:443 for quick verification. 3) Lower DNS TTL to 30s to speed potential failover. 4) Prep failover to standby NLB in another region if needed. I'll do the health-check tweak now. @Raj please apply SG rule and start captures.

Raj P (NetOps): Applied temp SG: allow tcp:443 from 10.64.0.0/16 on NLB nodes, expiry 45m. tcpdump started on nlb-node-3 (pcap saved). VPC Flow Logs show RSTs coming from 10.64.2.18 towards node port > 1024 after many concurrent connections.

Emily C (SRE): Updated tg-zenith-main health check -> TCP:443 timeout 12s, unhealthy threshold 6. Also increased NLB connect retries in runtime to smooth transient failures. Logged change id rc-1795601245.

IncidentBot: Action recorded: health-check update by Emily C at 1795601260. SG change by Raj P at 1795601290.

Zenith Support: With SG rule in place we ran `curl -v https://10.10.123.45:443` from bastion — connection succeeded and HTTP 200 returned. Their DNS resolution also stopped returning SERVFAIL. They confirmed they'd rotated an ACL rule earlier to block some ephemeral ranges and are reverting the change now.

Sophie (Support): Customer reports a big drop in 5xxs. Asked them to keep ACL relaxed and to share the exact ACL diff and the autoscaling history for their bastions.

Tara (Eng): As a precaution we've shifted 15% of traffic to standby NLB in us-west-2 and routed only non-critical tenants there. Telemetry shows stable latency and no errors on the standby path. Preparing rollback playbook for when customer confirms fix.

Miles (oncall): Summary & next steps: keep temp SG for 30m while Zenith patches ephemeral allocation; request they run a controlled restore during that window; maintain low DNS TTL for quick cutover; if flapping resumes, fail over traffic to standby NLB. I'll stay on until SG rollback.

Raj P (NetOps): Packet captures indicate NAT port exhaustion on customer's NAT IP — ephemeral ports depleted after sustained connection churn from bastions. Will remove temp SG at 1795603000 unless we see a regression.

Zenith Support: Confirmed they've patched bastion autoscaling and increased ephemeral port pool. Monitoring now. ETA 10m for full validation.

Miles (oncall): Handoff note: staying on for rollback and 15m stable validation after SG removal. @IncidentBot please mark mitigated when SG removed and 15m of stable metrics observed (no health-check failures, <1% 5xx).

IncidentBot: Acknowledged — will auto-update status per conditions. Participants logged. Thread remains open for postmortem artifacts (ACL diffs, bastion autoscale config, pcap).

Sophie (Support): Request to Zenith: please provide the exact ACL change and the autoscaling policy JSON, plus a timestamped diff so we can include a clear remediation in the postmortem (recommend explicit ephemeral port reserve and connection backoff).

Miles (oncall): Preliminary impact: customer-facing errors reduced to near zero after interventions. Marking customer impact as "mitigated" pending SG rollback and post-validation. Great work team. :white_check_mark:

---
Runbook references: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-egress-nlb and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/tenant-network-isolation.
